thread:
maria_csm: Heads-up: ArcWave onboarding spend jumped multiple times overnight. Renewal in 9 days. We need a short QBR cost slide + a safe mitigation plan before the review.

billing-bot: [automated] usage spike detected for account ArcWave. 48h peak = 1.1M tokens/hr. Estimated incremental daily cost: $6.2k. See: https://dash.redwood/arcwave/usage/peaks

raj_finops: Pulling logs now. Can we confirm whether this is production traffic or misrouted non-prod jobs? Also will run a quick spend projection for the QBR.

ellie_enablement: I dug in: their infra team accidentally pointed a nightly dev loader at the prod embed endpoint. It's hitting /embed-stream with huge batch size. They thought dev keys were isolated but one was copied.

tim_research: That explains the pattern. For immediate relief: short-term route-level soft-throttle + set prefix caching on /embed-stream for identical payloads. Medium-term: recommend switching backfill to small-embed-lite-quant for bulk index windows.

maria_csm: Can we make a one-hour emergency throttle so we can talk to them and get the dev job paused? I don't want to escalate to legal but this will blow their committed credits.

ops-bot: [action] Created temporary policy: throttle: /embed-stream -> 200 rps (1h) for account ArcWave. Owner: ops-oncall.

raj_finops: Quick forecast for QBR slide (7d window, snapshoted):
```
current baseline: $3,700/day
projected if no change: $9,600/day (7d avg)
mitigated w/ throttles + cache + model swap: ~$6,200/day (~35% reduction vs no-change)
```

sophie_sales: If we can buy them a predictable plan that avoids surprises, I'd rather offer an enablement play (1-hr onboarding clinic + a one-time ingest review) than a price concession. That keeps ARR intact.

ellie_enablement: I can run a 24h controlled ingest with the small-embed-lite-quant and caching enabled on a staging shard we replicate from ArcWave. Metrics I'll capture: tokens/day, median latency, recall@10. Ask: arcwave perm to run that test and permission to rotate the mistakenly copied dev key.

tim_research: On the eval: expected recall delta for small-embed-lite-quant vs large-embed is ~1.5-3% on typical dev corpora. Latency improvement usually >=30% for batch. Ill output a tiny csv and short blurb for the QBR. ETA 8 hours.

maria_csm: I just emailed ArcWave SRE and product: request pause of any non-prod loaders to prod endpoints, permission for the test, and confirm which teams touched API keys.

raj_finops: Action items for our side: 1) Add per-route cost waterfall to QBR deck (I'll attach in PR); 2) Create budget alert rule and auto-notify CS + account owner; 3) Draft a temporary credits estimate so AMs can decide on short-term relief.

ops-bot: [automated] budget-alert created: rule_id=br-arcwave-1745 threshold=120% baseline notify=#customer-success,maria_csm

sophie_sales: I'll draft renewal language: emphasize our proactive ops help, show the mitigation numbers, propose enablement session in lieu of short-term discount, and offer a one-week grace window if they need time to correct their pipeline.

ellie_enablement: For testing, Ill need a feature-flag to enable per-route caching for ArcWave only, plus a min-retry change so we don't amplify spikes. Can ops enable a canary flag?

ops-bot: [action] feature-flag "arcwave-pref-cache" created in canary. Toggle: OFF -> ON pending ArcWave consent.

maria_csm: Summary - immediate: ops throttled /embed-stream for 1h; billing alert set; I've asked ArcWave to pause dev loaders and to approve the canary test. Short-term: Ellie runs controlled ingest on quantized model; Tim runs eval; Raj prepares cost slide. We'll sync results here and I will fold final numbers into the QBR deck. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: [reminder scheduled] will post spend summary daily to thread until renewal.

maria_csm: Thanks team. Will update after ArcWave confirms permission.
